rule: C functions bare; ObjC methods `Class#selector` with keyword colons (`doX:withY:`); `[obj m]` → `obj.m`. | `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. If `m` is defined only on a superclass that is in the scan, the callee is `Superclass#m`.
notes: call_type convention used throughout this corpus: a callee that is a member of a type (`T#m`) or a receiver-qualified guess (`recv.m`, `.m`) is `method`; a C function (bare name) is `direct`. Class methods (+make) and instance methods share the `Class#selector` form. `other` is typed `Shape *` by its local declaration (decision A) so `[other doX:withY:]` is `Shape#doX:withY:` high. A C function is bare (`twice`, `driveShape`).
